minor: Cold open: 'hid billions borrowed from FTX' is firmer than the source, which says only that the version sent hid the borrowing from FTX. Use 'hid its borrowing from FTX' or cite the amount.
Cold open: 'Around June 2022' for the seven drafts has no sourced date. The source gives only Ellison's October 2023 testimony. Cite the date or say 'in 2022'.
'Analysts said the offer suggested Alameda needed FTT to stay above twenty-two dollars' has no source. Add a named analyst or outlet, or reword it as an inference.

'Ray's team spent two years recovering cash' does not match the May 2024 estimate, which came about 18 months after the filing. Say 'about eighteen months', or 'two years' only if you mean the period to the October 2024 approval.
'Over the seventy-two hours after Binance's post' is loose. Reuters' 72 hours is the window as of the founder's message on Nov 8, so say 'in about seventy-two hours' or 'by Nov 8'.
'Trial opened in Manhattan in October 2023' is not covered by a listed source, since the verdict entry is dated 2 Nov. Add a trial-start source or fold it into the existing entry.
The money-trail line ('from customers, through FTX, to Alameda, and on to its lenders') is a summary of witness accounts. Make it explicit that it is the prosecution's account.
The Ellison 'he directed me to commit these crimes' quote is attributed to 10 Oct trial testimony. Check that wording against the transcript before it goes on screen.
